name: realtime-chat-app-sqlite
description: Realtime chat app built with Bun, WebSocket, and SQLite

scripts.dev:server: test -f .env || { echo '.env: not found'; exit 1; }; bun --watch --env-file=.env src/server/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:client
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit
